The symptoms described—specifically migratory joint pain without swelling or redness, combined with extreme fatigue and low-grade fever—are clinically suggestive of **Rheumatic Fever**.

Rheumatic fever is an inflammatory disease that can develop as a complication of inadequately treated strep throat or scarlet fever. The "migratory" nature of the arthritis (pain moving from one joint to another) is a classic hallmark of this condition.

The mention of the "transparent material used to make windows" (glass) appears to be unrelated distractor text or a separate query embedded within the prompt, as it has no medical relevance to the symptoms described.
